info.title: Oracle Aconex M365 Agent Integration Gateway
info.description: Custom API Gateway wrapper connecting Microsoft 365 Copilot Agents securely to the Oracle Aconex Document Registry via dynamic user delegation.

get.summary: Retrieve project documents from Aconex register
get.description: Searches, filters, and retrieves a list of files, blueprints, or documents from a specific Aconex project instance using project ID and optional keywords.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: The unique internal alphanumeric identifier of the target Aconex project.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Optional keyword string or document designation sequence to filter search results by title or document number.

500.description: Internal server gateway error processing request.

post.summary: Upload and register a new document to Aconex
post.description: Uploads and registers a new physical drawing, blueprint, or document archive directly into the assigned Aconex project document library register.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: The unique structural project ID identifier where the document should be uploaded.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The binary file payload attachment pulled directly from the Microsoft 365 canvas app environment.

parameters.name: docNo
parameters.description: The strict official index configuration tracking number assigned to this piece of documentation.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: The readable plain text descriptive heading mapping to this document asset.

parameters.name: revision
parameters.description: The specific change variation identifier tracking context (e.g., A, B, 1, 2). Defaults to '1'.

parameters.name: discipline
parameters.description: The engineering division categorization context (e.g., Mechanical, Architectural, Civil).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The document workflow authorization phase setting (e.g., For Approval, Issued For Construction).

201.description: Document successful upload configuration response framework.

400.description: Bad Request. File or mandatory parameter parameters array configuration array missing.

401.description: Unauthorized. Expired or dropped M365 delegated credential context user session.

documentId.description: The structural target primary cloud key matching this precise record entry reference.

documentNo.description: The formal cataloging string number structure associated with the construction file track.

title.description: The explicit title context sequence assigned to the entity.

revision.description: The specific document version revision tracker notation layer.

discipline.description: Field sector categorization context tracking classification indices.

status.description: Life-cycle workflow position context assignment value strings.

uploadDate.description: ISO-8601 standardized generation context tracking timestamp tracking initialization parameters.
